'''Umberto''' is a NPC in {{Location|Ragunna City}} who only appears during Cloudy or Rainy weather during the day until 16:00. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Umberto:''' The rainy season in Ragunna seems to drag on longer every year... Ugh, how much longer do I have to sort through these soaked goods?

:'''Umberto:''' Are you looking to buy something? Ugh, look at me, getting ahead of myself! No one's going to want these now that they look like garbage.

:{{DIcon}}  Is this because of the rainy season?

:'''Umberto:''' Yeah. But you haven't seen the worst. There was a year when the rising seawater flooded the main streets of the city, nearly up to my waist.

:'''Umberto:''' Many Gondolas got stuck in the streets, and we spent two sleepless nights trying to salvage the soaked goods.

:{{DIcon}}  Did you not receive any help?

:'''Umberto:''' Of course, we did.

:'''Umberto:''' Surprisingly, the Order and the nobles sent out a fleet of Gondolas to rescue those in the lowlands, taking them to higher ground in the Order and Fisalia district for shelter.

:'''Umberto:''' That was the first time I saw the usually quiet Fisalia district so lively. Even though they acted all high and mighty, they still did their best to help.

:{{DIcon}}  So that's how they are.

:'''Umberto:''' Yeah, after that, I realized that some people from Fisalia can seem tough on the outside but are actually kind-hearted. They're not as malicious as we often think.
----
;(Night)
:'''Umberto:''' Hmph, easy for you to say from a distance... 

:'''Umberto:''' “Why don't you follow my example and move your goods to a Gondola?” 

:'''Umberto:''' And then, "I've lived my whole life, never seen a Ragunna native get seasick!"

:'''Umberto:''' Bah! Bah! Go to blazes, [[Sergio]]!
{{Dialogue End}}
